paper.title_en: Dynamical Selection of Horizon-BMS Goldstone Modes in Evaporating Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the dynamics of horizon soft degrees of freedom associated with near-horizon BMS supertranslations in an evaporating Vaidya-Schwarzschild black hole spacetime. Considering the dynamic nature of the supertranslation parameter, we derive its effective action directly from the Einstein-Hilbert action. The resulting Goldstone sector is intrinsically coupled to the evolving black hole dynamics, with the mass function entering the evolution of the Goldstone modes while the Goldstone configuration contributes to the dynamical evolution of the black hole mass. Azimuthal periodicity and regularity at the poles select the physically admissible angular sector and yields a mass-dependent $selection\ rule$ on the azimuthal modes. Consequently, the spectrum of horizon-supported Goldstone modes evolves with the black hole mass; as the horizon shrinks during evaporation, the horizon is left with a progressively reduced set of lower-order modes. The evaporation thus induces a dynamical filtering of the horizon soft sector, arising intrinsically from the black hole mass dynamics. These results provide an effective gravitational framework linking near-horizon BMS symmetry, dynamical Goldstone modes, and black hole evaporation, suggesting a direct connection between macroscopic horizon evolution with the microscopic organization of the gravitational soft degrees of freedom residing on the horizon.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨了视界软毛、BMS对称性与黑洞蒸发之间的相互作用，属于广义相对论基础的有力主题，并可能对黑洞热力学产生影响。它推导了有效作用量，并提出了一个新颖的筛选机制，与当前兴趣高度相关。
decision.title_zh: 蒸发黑洞中视界-BMS戈德斯通模式的动力学选择
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了蒸发中的Vaidya-Schwarzschild黑洞时空中与近视界BMS超平移相关的视界软自由度的动力学。考虑到超平移参数的动态性质，我们直接从爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量推导出它的有效作用量。由此产生的戈德斯通扇区本质上与黑洞演化动力学耦合，质量函数进入戈德斯通模式的演化，而戈德斯通构型则贡献于黑洞质量的动力学演化。方位角周期性以及极点处的正则性选择了物理上可允许的角扇区，并产生了一个依赖于质量的关于方位角模式的选择规则。因此，视界支持的戈德斯通模式的谱随黑洞质量演化；随着蒸发过程中视界收缩，视界最终只留下逐渐减少的低阶模式集。因此，蒸发引起了视界软扇区的动力学过滤，这内禀地源于黑洞质量动力学。这些结果提供了一个有效的引力框架，将近视界BMS对称性、动力学戈德斯通模式和黑洞蒸发联系起来，表明宏观视界演化与视界上居留的引力软自由度的微观组织之间存在直接联系。
